When scaling server-to-client push systems, the choice between Server-Sent Events (SSE) and WebSocket determines your operational burden under production load. Teams often pick WebSocket by default, then spend quarters containing emergent behavior at high concurrency: memory ballooning, opaque backpressure, and unstable p99 latency during noisy-neighbor periods.
